pinyin: néng rén bèi hòu yǒu néng rén
literal: capable · person · behind · there is · capable · person
natural: Behind every capable person is a more capable one

meaning.en: However talented you are, there is always someone even more able; stay humble.
meaning.zh: 再有本事的人，背后也有更有本事的人，要谦虚。

examples.zh: 别太得意，能人背后有能人，比你强的多得是。
examples.en: Don't be too pleased with yourself; there are plenty of people better than you.

examples.zh: 能人背后有能人，这次比赛让他明白了这个道理。
examples.en: This contest taught him that there is always someone more skilled.

usage.en: Same spirit as 一山更比一山高; a reminder to be modest.
usage.zh: 与“一山更比一山高”意思相近，劝人谦虚。

pinyin: hǎo nán ér zhì zài sì fāng
literal: good · man · ambition · lies in · four · directions
natural: A good man's ambitions lie in all four directions

meaning.en: A real man aims high and should go out into the wider world rather than stay at home.
meaning.zh: 有志气的男子应当胸怀大志，到外面闯荡，不安于家乡一隅。

equivalents: A rolling stone gathers no moss (in the positive sense)

examples.zh: 好男儿志在四方，毕业后他决定去南方闯一闯。
examples.en: A good man's ambition lies far afield, so after graduating he decided to try his luck in the south.

examples.zh: 好男儿志在四方，别老守在家门口。
examples.en: Real men have ambitions in every direction; don't stay by your own front door.

usage.en: Encouraging, used in send-offs. The male framing is traditional and now often replaced with 好儿女.
usage.zh: 送行时的勉励语；强调男子的说法较传统，现在也说“好儿女志在四方”。

pinyin: hǎo nán bù gēn nǚ dòu
literal: good · man · not · with · woman · fight
natural: A good man doesn't fight with women

meaning.en: A decent man should not argue or compete with a woman; he should be magnanimous.
meaning.zh: 有气度的男人不与女人争斗计较。

equivalents: I won't stoop to arguing with you

examples.zh: 好男不跟女斗，我让着你吧。
examples.en: A gentleman doesn't fight with a lady, so I'll let you have it.

examples.zh: 好男不跟女斗，这次就算了。
examples.en: A good man doesn't quarrel with women; let's drop it this time.

usage.en: Often said jokingly by a man backing down in a mild argument; sounds condescending if said seriously.
usage.zh: 男性在小争执中半开玩笑地让步时说；认真说则显得居高临下。

pinyin: hǎo mǎ bù chī huí tóu cǎo
literal: good · horse · not · eat · turning back · grass
natural: A good horse doesn't eat the grass it has left behind

meaning.en: A person of resolve doesn't go back to something or someone they have left behind, such as an old job or ex-partner.
meaning.zh: 有志气的人不会走回头路，如回到旧情人或旧工作那里。

examples.zh: 好马不吃回头草，既然分手了就别再联系了。
examples.en: A good horse doesn't go back for old grass; since you've broken up, don't contact them again.

examples.zh: 他说好马不吃回头草，不会回原来的公司。
examples.en: He said he wouldn't go backwards and won't return to his old company.

usage.en: Often used about ex-partners or former employers. Can be criticised as stubborn pride.
usage.zh: 常用于前任或旧单位；有时被批评为死要面子。

pinyin: hǎo sǐ bù rú lài huó zhe
literal: good · death · not as good as · poor · live · -ing
natural: A good death is worse than a poor life

meaning.en: Even a miserable life is better than dying, so keep going whatever happens.
meaning.zh: 哪怕活得再不堪，也比死了强，要坚持活下去。

equivalents: Better a live dog than a dead lion

examples.zh: 好死不如赖活着，再难也要撑下去。
examples.en: Even a wretched life is better than death; however hard it is, hold on.

examples.zh: 他经历了那么多苦难，仍然相信好死不如赖活着。
examples.en: After all his suffering, he still believes that being alive is better than dying a good death.

usage.en: A folk saying of survival; sometimes spoken with black humour or resignation. Not appropriate to say to someone in crisis.
usage.zh: 民间求生的说法，有时带自嘲或无奈。

synonyms: 留得青山在，不怕没柴烧

pinyin: hǎo xīn méi hǎo bào
literal: good · heart · no · good · reward
natural: Good intentions get no good reward

meaning.en: To be treated badly or blamed after trying to help someone.
meaning.zh: 出于好意帮助别人，反而得不到好的回报，甚至被怪罪。

equivalents: Kindness is wasted on some people

examples.zh: 我好心提醒他，他还怪我多嘴，真是好心没好报。
examples.en: I kindly warned him and he blamed me for speaking out of turn; no good deed goes unpunished.

examples.zh: 好心没好报，以后我再也不管闲事了。
examples.en: No good deed goes unpunished; I won't poke my nose in again.

usage.en: A complaint, often with 真是. Usually said of oneself after a thankless favour.
usage.zh: 多作抱怨，常说“真是好心没好报”，多指自己好心被辜负。

pinyin: hǎo rén yǒu hǎo bào
literal: good · people · have · good · reward
natural: Good people are rewarded

meaning.en: Those who do good will eventually be repaid with good fortune.
meaning.zh: 做好事的人最终会得到好的回报。

equivalents: Do good and good will come to you

examples.zh: 好人有好报，他帮过那么多人，现在大家都来帮他。
examples.en: Good people are rewarded; he helped so many people, and now they all help him.

examples.zh: 奶奶常说好人有好报，让我们多做善事。
examples.en: Grandma often says that good people will be rewarded and urges us to do good deeds.

usage.en: A common blessing or consolation; the counterpart of 恶有恶报.
usage.zh: 常用作祝福或安慰，与“恶有恶报”相对。

text: 好人不长命，祸害遗千年
pinyin: hǎo rén bù cháng mìng, huò hài yí qiān nián
literal: good · people · not · long · life, scourge · leave · thousand · years
natural: Good people die young, while scourges live a thousand years

meaning.en: Decent people often die early, while wicked ones live long; a bitter comment on life's unfairness.
meaning.zh: 好人往往早逝，坏人反而活得长久，感叹世事不公。

examples.zh: 好人不长命，祸害遗千年，这世道真不公平。
examples.en: The good die young while scourges live on for a thousand years; the world is so unfair.

examples.zh: 他那样的恶人，真是好人不长命，祸害遗千年。
examples.en: A rogue like him is proof that the good die young and the wicked live on.

usage.en: Bitter or sarcastic; also used jokingly of someone who just won't die from illness or accident.
usage.zh: 语气苦涩或讽刺，有时也半开玩笑说某人命硬。

pinyin: shì yào sān fēn dú
literal: is · medicine · three · parts · poison
natural: All medicine is three parts poison

meaning.en: Every medicine has side effects, so do not take drugs unnecessarily.
meaning.zh: 任何药物都有副作用，不要乱吃药。

equivalents: All medicine has its side effects
The cure may be worse than the disease

examples.zh: 是药三分毒，感冒了多喝水就行，别乱吃抗生素。
examples.en: All medicine has side effects; for a cold just drink more water and don't take antibiotics unnecessarily.

examples.zh: 医生说是药三分毒，能不吃就不吃。
examples.en: The doctor said every drug has side effects, so don't take it if you can avoid it.

usage.en: Common health advice, especially from older people; sometimes used to justify avoiding medication.
usage.zh: 常见的养生劝告，多出自长辈；有时也成为不愿吃药的理由。

pinyin: jiǔ bìng chéng liáng yī
literal: long · illness · become · good · doctor
natural: Long illness makes a good doctor

meaning.en: A person who has suffered an illness for a long time ends up knowing a lot about treating it; experience brings expertise.
meaning.zh: 病得久了，对病情和治疗懂得很多，就像医生一样；比喻经验丰富。

equivalents: A long illness makes you your own doctor

examples.zh: 久病成良医，他对这种病比一般医生还了解。
examples.en: Long illness makes a good doctor; he knows this disease better than the average doctor.

examples.zh: 她久病成良医，经常给病友出主意。
examples.en: Years of illness have made her something of an expert, and she often advises other patients.

usage.en: Also used generally of anyone who gains expertise through long experience of a problem.
usage.zh: 也泛指长期接触某事而变得内行。

pinyin: jiǔ bìng chuáng qián wú xiào zǐ
literal: long · illness · bedside · before · no · filial · son
natural: At a long-sick bed, no son stays filial

meaning.en: Caring for a long-term patient wears down even the most devoted children's patience.
meaning.zh: 病人久病不愈，再孝顺的子女也会渐渐失去耐心。

equivalents: Even the most devoted tire at a long sickbed

examples.zh: 久病床前无孝子，护工往往比子女更有耐心。
examples.en: Even the most filial child tires at a long sickbed, and the carer often has more patience than the children.

examples.zh: 老人卧病多年，真应了那句久病床前无孝子。
examples.en: The old man had been bedridden for years, which proved that even devoted sons tire at a long sickbed.

usage.en: A weary comment on caregiving; often used to explain why elderly patients need professional care.
usage.zh: 带无奈的感慨，常用于谈论老人长期护理问题。

pinyin: xīn bìng hái xū xīn yào yī
literal: heart · illness · still · must · heart · medicine · cure
natural: A heart sickness needs a heart medicine

meaning.en: Emotional troubles can only be cured by resolving their emotional cause.
meaning.zh: 心里的病要从心里的根源去解决。

equivalents: The cure for heartache lies in the heart

examples.zh: 心病还须心药医，她只有放下过去才能好起来。
examples.en: A sickness of the heart needs a remedy of the heart; she can only recover by letting go of the past.

examples.zh: 医生说他是心病，心病还须心药医。
examples.en: The doctor said his trouble was emotional and had to be solved at its source.

usage.en: Often cited with 解铃还须系铃人 (whoever tied the bell must untie it). Also 心病还得心药医.
usage.zh: 常与“解铃还须系铃人”并用；也说“心病还得心药医”。

pinyin: xīn jìng zì rán liáng
literal: heart · calm · naturally · cool
natural: A calm heart is naturally cool

meaning.en: If you keep your mind calm, you feel cooler; calm lessens heat and frustration.
meaning.zh: 心里平静了，就不觉得热；比喻心态平和就能减轻烦躁。

examples.zh: 天气这么热，心静自然凉，我们喝杯茶吧。
examples.en: It's so hot, but a calm heart stays cool; let's have some tea.

examples.zh: 别着急，心静自然凉，事情会解决的。
examples.en: Don't be anxious; stay calm and things will work out.

usage.en: Often said in summer heat or to calm someone's temper.
usage.zh: 常在炎夏或劝人平心静气时说。

pinyin: rén xīn dōu shì ròu zhǎng de
literal: people · heart · all · are · flesh · grown · 's
natural: Everyone's heart is made of flesh

meaning.en: Everyone has feelings, so kindness will be met with kindness.
meaning.zh: 每个人都有感情，真心对待别人，别人也会感动、回报。

examples.zh: 人心都是肉长的，你对她好，她会明白的。
examples.en: Everyone has a heart of flesh; if you are good to her, she will understand.

examples.zh: 人心都是肉长的，他再硬也被感动了。
examples.en: Everyone has feelings; however hard he was, he was moved.

usage.en: Used to appeal for sympathy or to explain why kindness works. Often 人心是肉长的.
usage.zh: 常用于恳求同情或说明善意有效；也说“人心是肉长的”。

text: 人心换人心，八两换半斤
pinyin: rén xīn huàn rén xīn, bā liǎng huàn bàn jīn
literal: heart · exchange · heart, eight · liang · exchange · half · jin
natural: Heart for heart, eight liang for half a jin

meaning.en: Sincerity is repaid with sincerity; if you treat others well they will treat you well in return.
meaning.zh: 用真心换真心，你待人好，人家也待你好。

examples.zh: 人心换人心，八两换半斤，你真诚待人，朋友自然多。
examples.en: Heart for heart, an even exchange; treat people sincerely and you will have plenty of friends.

examples.zh: 人心换人心，八两换半斤，他帮过我，我一定要报答。
examples.en: Heart for heart; he helped me, and I must repay him.

usage.en: In the old system 16 liang = 1 jin, so 八两 = 半斤: an equal exchange. Said warmly.
usage.zh: 旧制一斤十六两，八两恰好是半斤，比喻对等。

text: 以小人之心度君子之腹
pinyin: yǐ xiǎo rén zhī xīn duó jūn zǐ zhī fù
literal: with · petty person · 's · heart · measure · gentleman · 's · belly
natural: To measure a gentleman's heart by a petty man's

meaning.en: To judge a decent person's motives by one's own low standards.
meaning.zh: 用自己卑劣的想法去揣测正人君子的心思。

examples.zh: 你这是以小人之心度君子之腹，人家只是想帮忙。
examples.en: You're judging an honest man by your own low standards; he only wanted to help.

examples.zh: 别以小人之心度君子之腹，他不是那样的人。
examples.en: Don't judge a good person by your own petty mind; he's not that kind of man.

usage.en: Often as a rebuke to someone who suspects others unfairly. 度 is read duó (to estimate).
usage.zh: 常用于斥责无端猜疑别人的人；“度”读 duó，揣测。

text: 后事如何，且听下回分解
pinyin: hòu shì rú hé, qiě tīng xià huí fēn jiě
literal: later · events · how, so · listen · next · chapter · explain
natural: What happens next, hear in the next chapter

meaning.en: Stock closing line of traditional Chinese serial novels and storytelling; now used jokingly to end a story with a cliffhanger.
meaning.zh: 章回小说和评书每回结尾的套话；现常用来半开玩笑地吊人胃口。

examples.zh: 我先讲到这儿，后事如何，且听下回分解。
examples.en: I'll stop here; what happens next, we'll find out in the next episode.

examples.zh: 他在群里发了半段故事，最后写着：后事如何，且听下回分解。
examples.en: He posted half a story in the group chat and ended with 'To be continued.'

usage.en: A formula from storytellers' chapter endings; today used humorously, especially online.
usage.zh: 源自说书和章回小说的回末套语，今多作调侃，尤其在网络上。

pinyin: shì shàng méi yǒu hòu huǐ yào
literal: world · on · there is no · regret · medicine
natural: There is no regret medicine in the world

meaning.en: What is done cannot be undone, so think before you act.
meaning.zh: 做过的事无法挽回，所以事前要慎重。

equivalents: There's no use crying over spilt milk
You can't turn back the clock

examples.zh: 世上没有后悔药，做决定前要三思。
examples.en: There is no medicine for regret, so think twice before deciding.

examples.zh: 世上没有后悔药，既然错了就想办法弥补。
examples.en: You can't undo the past, so since you've made a mistake, make up for it.

usage.en: Used as a warning or consolation. Also 后悔药没处买.
usage.zh: 用于告诫或叹息；也说“后悔药没处买”。

pinyin: jìn rén shì, tīng tiān mìng
literal: exhaust · human · effort, listen to · heaven · fate
natural: Do all you can, then accept fate

meaning.en: Do your best, then accept whatever outcome comes.
meaning.zh: 尽了自己最大的努力，然后接受结果。

equivalents: Do your best and leave the rest to fate

examples.zh: 该准备的都准备好了，尽人事，听天命吧。
examples.en: I've prepared all I can, so do your best and leave the rest to fate.

examples.zh: 考前尽人事，听天命，别太焦虑。
examples.en: Do your best before the exam and accept the outcome; don't be too anxious.

usage.en: Sometimes written 尽人事而听天命. Calm, resigned tone.
usage.zh: 也作“尽人事而听天命”，语气平和、顺其自然。

pinyin: qiàn zhài huán qián, tiān jīng dì yì
literal: owe · debt · return · money, heaven · principle · earth · righteousness
natural: Paying debts is a law of heaven and earth

meaning.en: Repaying what you owe is only natural and right.
meaning.zh: 借了钱就要还，这是理所当然的。

examples.zh: 欠债还钱，天经地义，你不能赖账。
examples.en: Debts must be repaid, as is only right, and you can't refuse to pay.

examples.zh: 欠债还钱，天经地义，法院判他限期还款。
examples.en: A debt is a debt; the court ordered him to repay by a deadline.

usage.en: Often used by creditors, in court and in news; can also be used as a general moral principle.
usage.zh: 多用于债权人、法庭和新闻，也可泛指道德准则。

pinyin: wú lì bù qǐ zǎo
literal: no · profit · not · rise · early
natural: No one gets up early without profit

meaning.en: People will not make an effort unless there is something in it for them.
meaning.zh: 没有好处，谁也不会费力去做。

equivalents: There's no such thing as a free lunch

examples.zh: 商人无利不起早，他肯帮忙一定有原因。
examples.en: Merchants don't rise early without profit, so he must have a reason for helping.

examples.zh: 无利不起早，别指望他白帮忙。
examples.en: No one gets up early without profit, so don't expect him to help for nothing.

usage.en: Cynical but often matter-of-fact when describing business.
usage.zh: 略带犬儒色彩，描述商业行为时语气常较平实。

pinyin: qīn xiōng dì, míng suàn zhàng
literal: own · brothers, clearly · calculate · accounts
natural: Even brothers should settle accounts clearly

meaning.en: Even close family should keep clear accounts in money matters to avoid disputes.
meaning.zh: 即使是亲兄弟，钱财往来也要算清楚，免得日后产生矛盾。

examples.zh: 亲兄弟，明算账，借钱还是写个借条吧。
examples.en: Even brothers should keep accounts clear, so let's write an IOU for the loan.

examples.zh: 合伙开店，亲兄弟，明算账，利润怎么分要说清楚。
examples.en: When going into business together, even brothers should be clear about money, so we must say how profits are split.

usage.en: Practical advice for money matters among family and friends. 账 may also be written 帐.
usage.zh: 在亲友间涉及钱财时的务实建议；“账”也作“帐”。

text: 打虎亲兄弟，上阵父子兵
pinyin: dǎ hǔ qīn xiōng dì, shàng zhèn fù zǐ bīng
literal: fight · tiger · own · brothers, go into · battle · father · son · soldiers
natural: To fight a tiger, take your brothers; to go to war, take father and son

meaning.en: In a crisis you can best rely on close family, who will fight alongside you with all their hearts.
meaning.zh: 危急关头，最可靠的是亲人，他们会同心协力。

examples.zh: 打虎亲兄弟，上阵父子兵，家族企业遇到危机时全家人都来帮忙。
examples.en: In a crisis the whole family rallies round, brothers fighting the tiger and fathers and sons going into battle together.

examples.zh: 打虎亲兄弟，上阵父子兵，他们三兄弟一起创业。
examples.en: The three brothers started a business together, relying on each other.

usage.en: Often used about family firms and teams; a downside is nepotism.
usage.zh: 多用于家族企业和团队；也有任人唯亲的负面意味。

pinyin: xuè nóng yú shuǐ
literal: blood · thicker · than · water
natural: Blood is thicker than water

meaning.en: Family ties are stronger than other relationships.
meaning.zh: 亲情比其他关系更为深厚牢固。

examples.zh: 血浓于水，他们再怎么吵架也还是一家人。
examples.en: Blood is thicker than water; however much they quarrel, they're still family.

examples.zh: 血浓于水，海外华人始终牵挂着祖国。
examples.en: Blood is thicker than water; overseas Chinese always care about the motherland.

usage.en: Used for family and also for national or ethnic bonds. 血 is read xuè in this phrase.
usage.zh: 用于亲情，也用于民族、同胞之情；此处“血”读 xuè。

synonyms: 打虎亲兄弟，上阵父子兵

pinyin: shǒu xīn shǒu bèi dōu shì ròu
literal: palm · back of hand · all · are · flesh
natural: Palm and back of the hand are both flesh

meaning.en: Parents love all their children equally; it is hard to choose between two people one cares about.
meaning.zh: 对几个孩子都一样疼爱，难以取舍；比喻对双方都不忍偏袒。

equivalents: A parent loves all their children equally

examples.zh: 两个孩子吵架，手心手背都是肉，我不知道该帮谁。
examples.en: The two children are quarrelling and I love them both equally, so I don't know whom to side with.

examples.zh: 手心手背都是肉，爸妈不愿意偏向任何一个。
examples.en: Both are my flesh and blood, and Mum and Dad refuse to take sides.

usage.en: Typically said by parents or anyone forced to choose between two parties they care about.
usage.zh: 多为父母或需要在两个关心的人之间做选择的人所说。
